metadata.arabic_model_strategy: validation-selected DODa Arabic weighting plus calibrated ary-arabic threshold
metadata.selection_dataset: validation only: DODa Arabic validation + Darija-LID validation
metadata.rule_mode: Arabic classifier first with calibrated threshold; heuristics fallback only

darija_lid_metadata.phase: ary Arabic-script vs MSA only; other dialects excluded from training
darija_lid_metadata.upstream_test_holdout_note: Darija-LID train/test splits are used as the hardest held-out diagnostic boundary. This is not a strict upstream-source-disjoint split: within the selected ary/MSA phase, each class is dominated by one upstream source, so a stricter by-source split would remove a class from training.

current_hybrid.description: pre-J2D rule-heavy Arabic hybrid; baseline kept in J2C report

calibrated_safe_rules.description: same result as calibrated classifier; Arabic hard overrides disabled when artifact is available
